8:       # Checks that the backslash of a line continuation is separated from
9:       # preceding text by exactly one space (default) or zero spaces.

11:       # @example EnforcedStyle: space (default)
12:       #   # bad
13:       #   'a'\
14:       #   'b'  \
15:       #   'c'

17:       #   # good

23:       #   # bad

32:       class LineContinuationSpacing < Base
33:         include RangeHelp
34:         extend AutoCorrector

36:         def on_new_investigation
37:           return unless processed_source.raw_source.include?('\\')
38: 
39:           last_line = last_line(processed_source)
40: 
41:           processed_source.raw_source.lines.each_with_index do |line, index|
42:             break if index >= last_line
43: 
44:             line_number = index + 1
45:             investigate(line, line_number)
46:           end
47:         end

51:         def investigate(line, line_number)
52:           offensive_spacing = find_offensive_spacing(line)
53:           return unless offensive_spacing
54: 
55:           range = source_range(
56:             processed_source.buffer,
57:             line_number,
58:             line.length - offensive_spacing.length - 1,
59:             offensive_spacing.length
60:           )
61: 
62:           return if ignore_range?(range)
63: 
64:           add_offense(range) { |corrector| autocorrect(corrector, range) }
65:         end

67:         def find_offensive_spacing(line)
68:           if no_space_style?
69:             line[/\s+\\$/, 0]
70:           elsif space_style?
71:             line[/((?<!\s)|\s{2,})\\$/, 0]
72:           end
73:         end

75:         def message(_range)
76:           if no_space_style?
77:             'Use zero spaces in front of backslash.'
78:           elsif space_style?
79:             'Use one space in front of backslash.'
80:           end
81:         end

83:         def autocorrect(corrector, range)
84:           correction = if no_space_style?
85:                          '\\'
86:                        elsif space_style?
87:                          ' \\'
88:                        end
89:           corrector.replace(range, correction)
90:         end

97:           ast.each_node(:str, :dstr, :array).with_object(Set.new) do |literal, ranges|

101:               next unless literal.percent_literal?
102: 
103:               ranges << loc.expression
104:             elsif literal.heredoc?
105:               ranges << loc.heredoc_body
106:             elsif loc.respond_to?(:begin) && loc.begin
107:               ranges << loc.expression
108:             end
109:           end

147:         def leading_space_raw_lines(processed_source, node)
148:           @leading_continuation_cache ||= {}
149:           key = [processed_source.object_id, node.object_id, :raw_lines]
150:           cached = @leading_continuation_cache[key]
151:           return cached if cached

153:           first_line = node.first_line
154:           size = (node.first_line..node.last_line).size
155:           lines = processed_source.raw_source.lines[first_line - 1, size]
156:           @leading_continuation_cache[key] = lines
157:           lines

160:         def leading_space_continuation?(line, line_num, node)
161:           @leading_continuation_cache ||= {}
162:           return false unless line.end_with?("\\\n")
163: 
164:           children = node.children
165:           spanning = children.any? do |child|
166:             next false unless child.respond_to?(:first_line) && child.respond_to?(:last_line)
167: 
168:             (child.first_line...child.last_line).cover?(line_num) && child.multiline?
169:           end
170:           @leading_continuation_cache[:last_continuation_check] = !spanning
171:           !spanning
172:         end

240:         def leading_space_each_offense(processed_source, node, cop_config)
241:           @leading_continuation_cache ||= {}
242:           return unless node.source.include?('\\')
243: 
244:           end_of_first_line = node.source_range.begin_pos - node.source_range.column
245:           lines = leading_space_raw_lines(processed_source, node)
246:           offenses = []
247:           lines.each_cons(2).with_index(node.first_line) do |(raw_line_one, raw_line_two), line_num|
248:             end_of_first_line += raw_line_one.length
249:             next unless leading_space_continuation?(raw_line_one, line_num, node)
250: 
251:             offense = leading_space_offense_for_pair(raw_line_one, raw_line_two, end_of_first_line, cop_config)
252:             next unless offense
253: 
254:             offenses << offense
255:             yield(*offense) if block_given?
256:           end
257:           @leading_continuation_cache[:offenses] = offenses
258:           offenses
259:         end

261:         def leading_space_offense_for_pair(first_line, second_line, end_of_first_line, cop_config)
262:           @leading_continuation_cache ||= {}
263:           if leading_space_style_leading?(cop_config)
264:             matches = leading_space_match_leading_offense(first_line)
265:             return unless matches
266: 
267:             bounds = leading_space_leading_bounds(end_of_first_line, matches)
268:             insert_pos = leading_space_leading_insert_pos(end_of_first_line, second_line)
269:             @leading_continuation_cache[:last_pair] = [bounds, insert_pos, matches[:trailing_spaces]]
270:             [bounds, insert_pos, matches[:trailing_spaces]]
271:           else
272:             matches = leading_space_match_trailing_offense(second_line)
273:             return unless matches
274: 
275:             bounds = leading_space_trailing_bounds(end_of_first_line, matches)
276:             insert_pos = leading_space_trailing_insert_pos(end_of_first_line, first_line)
277:             @leading_continuation_cache[:last_pair] = [bounds, insert_pos, matches[:leading_spaces]]
278:             [bounds, insert_pos, matches[:leading_spaces]]
279:           end
280:         end

301:           tokens = alignment_remove_optarg_equals(tokens, processed_source)

317:         def alignment_remove_optarg_equals(asgn_tokens, processed_source)
318:           @token_spacing_cache ||= {}
319:           ast = processed_source.ast
320:           unless ast
321:             @token_spacing_cache[:optarg_equals] = asgn_tokens
322:             return asgn_tokens
323:           end
324: 
325:           optargs = ast.each_node(:optarg)
326:           optarg_eql = optargs.to_set { |optarg| optarg.loc.operator.begin_pos }
327:           filtered = asgn_tokens.reject { |token| optarg_eql.include?(token.begin_pos) }
328:           @token_spacing_cache[:optarg_equals] = filtered
329:           filtered

334:           cached = @token_spacing_cache[:comment_lines]

337:           lines = processed_source.comments.map(&:loc).select do |range|

344:         def alignment_aligned_words?(range, line)
345:           @token_spacing_cache ||= {}
346:           left_edge = range.column
347:           if left_edge.positive? && /\s\S/.match?(line[left_edge - 1, 2])
348:             @token_spacing_cache[:aligned_words] = true
349:             return true
350:           end

352:           token = range.source
353:           aligned = token == line[left_edge, token.length]

530:         def alignment_relevant_assignment_lines(line_range, processed_source)
531:           @token_spacing_cache ||= {}
532:           result = []
533:           original_line_indent = processed_source.line_indentation(line_range.first)
534:           relevant_line_indent_at_level = true
535:           lines = alignment_assignment_lines(processed_source)
536: 
537:           line_range.each do |line_number|
538:             current_line_indent = processed_source.line_indentation(line_number)
539:             blank_line = processed_source.lines[line_number - 1].blank?
540: 
541:             if (current_line_indent < original_line_indent && !blank_line) ||
542:                (relevant_line_indent_at_level && blank_line)
543:               break
544:             end
545: 
546:             result << line_number if lines.include?(line_number) &&
547:                                      current_line_indent == original_line_indent
548: 
549:             unless blank_line
550:               relevant_line_indent_at_level = current_line_indent == original_line_indent
551:             end
552:           end
553: 
554:           @token_spacing_cache[:relevant_assignment_lines] = result
555:           result

part.text:
Fixed. In `ignored_literal_ranges` (lib/rubocop/cop/layout/line_continuation_spacing.rb:97), the cop only ignored `str`/`dstr`/percent-array literals, so backslash continuations inside `Regexp` (and `xstr`) literals were flagged and "corrected" — corrupting the regexp by inserting a space.

The change adds `:regexp` and `:xstr` to the traversed node types and collects their `loc.expression` ranges as ignored, so `ignore_range?` now skips continuations inside them.

Verification: `spec/rubocop/cop/layout/line_continuation_spacing_spec.rb` (31 examples, 0 failures) and the full cop suite (22088 examples, 0 failures) all pass.
